blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — It has been four years since Sheena Sasil, 36, a resident of Barangay Buaya, Lapu-Lapu City, last worked as a call center agent. She resigned from her online job in 2022 to take care of her daughter, Zowie, who was then only three years old. Now that her daughter is seven, Sasil is back on the job hunt, hoping to find employment to help provide for her child’s needs. READ: Attending a job fair?
